title: Recover Korean console after crash reboot
desc: When Korean/Hangul input fails only in console after system crash reboot or Kernel-Power 41, run scripts/recover-korean-console.ps1 before substantive work. It restarts TextInputHost/ctfmon and aligns PowerShell console encodings to UTF-8.
steps: Run powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\recover-korean-console.ps1 from repo root.
If ctfmon start reports 0xc0000142 but ctfmon is already running, treat it as usually sufficient.
If the already-open console still has stale IME state, open a new Windows Terminal tab before suggesting another reboot.
For repeated crash-boot symptoms, consider disabling Windows Fast Startup separately.
author: claude
